title: Patch: undo toasts for deleting decks, trios and custom cards and removing friends

**Issue #2119 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2119: Patch: undo toasts for deleting decks, trios and custom cards and removing friends Opened by @squishy-squooby. Part of #2036. This is a patch of its own: it goes live when it merges and builds on `main` beside the tracker's other parts. ## What Four destructive actions change: - Deleting a deck (`game/deckbuilder/DeckEditor.tsx:560`), a trio (`TrioEditor.tsx:338`) or a custom card (`creator/Creator.tsx`, `confirmDelete`) currently asks first with "This can't be undone". Those confirms go. - Remove friend (`together/TogetherRoute.tsx:201`) acts at once with no way back, and getting the friend back takes a new request. Instead, each of the four: - **Goes at once.** The item leaves the screen immediately, and a toast appears for `UNDO_WINDOW_MS` with the matching words ("Deck deleted · Undo", "Trio deleted · Undo", "Card deleted · Undo", "Friend removed · Undo"). - **Holds the server call.** The `DELETE` (or unfriend) is held until the window closes. If the page hides first (`pagehide`, or `visibilitychange` to hidden), it is sent at once as a `keepalive` request, the way `deckbuilder/sync.ts` sends unsaved decks. - **Undo** puts the item back where it was and sends nothing. A deck that comes back fills the trio slots it held again. - **No resave.** While a deck's delete is held, `sync.ts` never saves that deck again, and no trio shows it. - **One toast at a time.** A second delete while one is held sends the first at once and replaces its toast. - **Failure.** If the held call fails when it goes, the item comes back and the screen shows the server's words. - **The toast itself** is `role="status"` and doesn't take focus. Its Undo is reachable by keyboard, it sits inside the safe-area insets, and under Reduce motion it appears without sliding. - **Concede is unchanged.** It keeps its confirm (`ConfirmConcede.tsx`), because it is a game action. - **Ruling.** SPEC §10 decides neither the undo window nor the held call, so add a ruling note from this issue's block for both. ## Done when vitest checks, for each of the four actions, that: - the item is gone at once and nothing is sent; - Undo restores it and sends nothing; - the window's end sends the call exactly once; - `pagehide` sends it at once; - a failed call restores the item and shows the error. It also checks that a held deck is never saved again by `sync.ts`, and that its trio slots come back on Undo. ## Ground rules (from #2036) - Read `apps/web/README.md` before changing the client. CLAUDE.md rule 7: nothing here predicts, enforces or reveals game state. - Every number is a named constant (rule 9). - Every animation and gesture follows Reduce motion: the media query, and `data-motion="reduced"` from the settings panel. - If SPEC §10 doesn't already decide a behaviour, add a ruling note numbered from this issue's own block (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers), with its proving test named after it. - Gates: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`. - The PR closes this issue, says `Part of #2036`, and carries one `## Player note` line. ## Plan _Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40580530253)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Deleting a deck, trio or custom card, and removing a friend, take the item off the screen at once. The three confirms and Remove's inline question go. In their place a `role="status"` toast shows for `UNDO_WINDOW_MS`, saying "Deck deleted · Undo", "Trio deleted · Undo", "Card deleted · Undo" or "Friend removed · Undo". The request waits for the window to end. It goes at once in three cases: - the page hides (sent with `keepalive`); - the player leaves the screen; - a second delete comes, which also replaces the toast. Undo restores the item and sends nothing. A failed request restores the item and shows the server's words. A held deck is never saved and no trio shows it; its trio slots come back on Undo. No confirm and no Remove question is left. Block and Concede are unchanged. - [ ] The request goes once at the window's end, and at once on: - a second delete; - a create or import in the workshop; - a page hide (with keepalive); - leaving the screen. - [ ] Undo sends nothing. A failure restores the item with the server's words. - [ ] A held deck is not saved and is in no trio; its slots come back on Undo. - [ ] The toast is a status, takes no focus, has a keyboard-reachable Undo, sits inside the safe areas and does not slide under Reduce motion. - [ ] The tests pass, and these are green: the web typecheck, eslint over `apps/web e2e`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, and the harness's checks. - [ ] The decisions under Open questions are recorded in the PR. ## Risks - **Unload.** For a deck that is in a trio, the trio PUT goes before the DELETE, so a real page unload can cut the DELETE off. `deleteDeck` has already written the deletion to the mirror, so the next visit sends it (R256). Do not reorder the pass. - **Effect order.** `useUndoHold` must come before the store's start/stop effect. `send` also flushes on its own, so a stopped store still sends. - **Caps.** The store still counts a hidden deck, so without `sendNow()`, New deck at the cap does nothing. - **Practice (#1991).** During a hold, `saved:` would name the wrong deck; that is why `practicePathOf` checks `held`. - **Rule 7 and i18n (R711000).** Nothing here decides a game rule. Every new `t()` literal needs its zh-CN entry. ## Open questions These are decisions the builder records; a person may overturn any of them. - `UNDO_WINDOW_MS` is 8000 ms. Rejected: 5000 ms, which is short for a screen reader user. - Decks and trios come back only on a refusal; offline or a server error keeps R256's retry. Rejected: restoring on every failure, which would break offline deletion. Custom cards and friends come back on any failure. - Undo reopens the deck or trio in the editor. A custom card reopens only if the editor holds an untouched new card. - A create or import in the workshop sends the held deletion first. Rejected: leaving hidden decks out of the cap, which would let the client create a deck the server then refuses. - Leaving the screen sends a plain request; `keepalive` is used only when the page hides. - The old confirm strings stay in `zh-CN.json`. ````
